description: This file defines the TurndownService class, a JavaScript library for converting HTML to Markdown. It includes rules for handling various HTML elements, whitespace management, and plugin support.

classes.name: Rules
classes.description: Manages a collection of rules used to convert HTML to Markdown.

classes.name: TurndownService
classes.description: Main class providing methods to convert HTML or DOM nodes to Markdown, with plugin and rule management.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Merges multiple objects into one, similar to Object.assign.

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: Creates a string by repeating a character a specified number of times.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if the input can be converted (string or DOM node).

methods.name: process
methods.description: Converts a DOM node and its children to Markdown.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Finalizes the Markdown output, applying rules and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: replacementForNode
methods.description: Converts a DOM node to its Markdown representation based on rules.

methods.name: separatingNewlines
methods.description: Determines the number of newlines to separate Markdown blocks.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins two Markdown strings with appropriate newlines.

methods.name: htmlParser
methods.description: Creates or returns an HTML parser for converting strings to DOM.

methods.name: RootNode
methods.description: Creates a root DOM node from an HTML string or existing node, with whitespace collapsed.
